layout.heading: Building Digital Experiences That Matter
layout.subheading: Full-stack developer and product designer passionate about creating beautiful, functional applications that solve real problems.

layout.content:
Hello, I'm a Software Engineer

With over 8 years of experience in full-stack development, I specialize in building scalable web applications, mobile apps, and AI-powered solutions. My journey in tech began with a curiosity about how things work and evolved into a passion for creating products that make a difference.

I've had the privilege of working with startups, agencies, and enterprise clients across various industries including music technology, healthcare, finance, and e-commerce. Each project taught me something new and reinforced my belief that great software is built at the intersection of beautiful design and solid engineering.

My Approach

I believe in user-centered design, clean code, and iterative development. Every project starts with understanding the problem deeply, then crafting a solution that's both elegant and practical.

My development philosophy centers on three core principles:

  • Quality over Quantity: I'd rather build one feature exceptionally well than ten features poorly.
  • Performance Matters: Fast, responsive applications create better user experiences and drive better business outcomes.
  • Continuous Learning: Technology evolves rapidly, and staying current with best practices is non-negotiable.

Technical Expertise

I work across the full stack with a focus on modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems:

Frontend Development

  • React, Next.js, Vue.js, React Native
  • TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
  • Tailwind CSS, styled-components, SASS
  • Redux, Zustand, React Query
  • GSAP, Framer Motion

Backend Development

  • Node.js, Express, Fastify
  • Python, FastAPI, Django
  • PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • REST APIs, GraphQL
  • WebSockets, real-time systems

Cloud & DevOps

  • AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS)
  • Docker, Kubernetes
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions
  • Vercel, Netlify, Railway

AI & Machine Learning

  • OpenAI GPT integration
  • PyTorch, TensorFlow
  • Natural Language Processing
  • Audio processing & analysis

Beyond Code

When I'm not coding, you'll find me:

  • 🎵 Producing electronic music and experimenting with synthesizers
  • 📚 Reading about design, psychology, and system thinking
  • 🏃 Running trails and staying active
  • ☕ Exploring specialty coffee shops
  • ✈️ Traveling and experiencing different cultures

I'm always excited to collaborate on interesting projects, especially those that combine technology with creativity. If you're working on something cool, let's chat!

layout.heading: Let's Work Together
layout.text: I'm currently available for select freelance projects and full-time opportunities. Whether you need a complete application built from scratch or help scaling an existing product, I'd love to hear about your project.

layout.heading: Let's Build Something Amazing
layout.subheading: Have a project in mind? I'd love to hear about it. Drop me a line and let's start a conversation.

layout.content:
Get In Touch

I'm always open to discussing new projects, creative ideas, or opportunities to be part of your vision. Whether you have a fully-formed concept or just the beginnings of an idea, I'd love to chat.

The best way to reach me is via email. I typically respond within 24-48 hours.

Email: hello@example.com

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (open to remote work)

What to Include

When reaching out, it's helpful to include:

  • Project Overview: A brief description of what you're building
  • Timeline: When you'd like to get started and any key deadlines
  • Budget Range: Having a ballpark helps ensure we're aligned
  • Tech Stack: If you have preferences or requirements

Don't worry if you don't have all these details figured out yet - we can work through them together!

Current Availability

I'm currently accepting:

  • ✅ Full-time opportunities (remote or SF Bay Area)
  • ✅ Contract projects (3+ months preferred)
  • ✅ Consulting engagements
  • ❌ Short-term freelance gigs (< 1 month)

Last updated: January 2026

Frequently Asked Questions

What's your typical project timeline?

It depends on scope, but most projects range from 2-6 months. I can provide a more accurate estimate after our initial conversation.

Do you work with startups?

Absolutely! I love working with early-stage startups and can be flexible with arrangements including equity compensation for the right opportunity.

What's your hourly rate?

My rates vary based on project scope and commitment. Let's discuss your specific needs and I'll provide a transparent quote.

Do you provide ongoing support?

Yes! I offer maintenance retainers for apps I've built and can provide ongoing technical support and feature development.

layout.heading: Ready to Start?
layout.text: Send me an email and let's schedule a call to discuss your project. I'm excited to learn about what you're building!
